t: Work menu: Who owns a decision.
Who can be the owner of a decision or action item: you can give it to your team, anyone else is asked and must accept, and an owner can say Not mine.
In this video, you will learn how to pick an owner, ask someone above you, accept or decline when you are asked, and hand something back.
Every decision and action item has an owner. ShankhNaad follows the org chart when you choose one, so nobody can push work onto someone above them.
Press Add, and write what needs to be done.
You can make yourself, or anyone below you, the owner straight away. Everyone else is marked: will be asked.
Pick your manager, Rohan. A note explains it: he will be asked to accept, and until he does, it stays with you.
Press Save. Under your name, the list now shows: asked Rohan, waiting.
When someone asks you to own something, it appears at the top, under Waiting for your answer.
Press Accept, and it is yours: it moves to Yours to do. Press Decline, and it stays with whoever asked. They are told either way.
If you own something that is not yours to do, open it and press Not mine. It goes back to whoever recorded it.
Workspace admins can make anyone the owner straight away.
That completes the Who owns a decision page.
